_sheets: Alan, 2026-10-23: the board follows both schedule books, each feeding only its own weekends so a show never flips between them. Until the January meeting the Sept-Feb book feeds through February and the Jan-May book from March 1; from the morning of the meeting (handover.on) the Jan-May book feeds every weekend from January 1, and only what the team changed in that book since its first load comes over then (Alan settled the six shows the two books disagreed on). seasonYear is the year of a weekend header from August on (January-July headers are the next year), so the Jan-May 2027 book is 2026. dateLabels weekday: that book's day cells still hold earlier years' dates. firstLoad (scripts/sheet-sync.mjs --first-load jan-may): its March-May rows were still 2026's, so they came on as Prospective 2027 shows with no reps, a row marked out in column B or C (deadPattern) as Cancelled, column B Elite as Elite, and the skip rows (last year's copies of shows already on the board) left off. Alan's defaults, 2026-10-23.
_requestPendingDays: A show the booking sweep requested keeps Booking Request Submitted this many days with no VC record, then goes back to Booking Request Needed (Olean works requests in 1-2 business days).
_tierRules: Alan, 2026-09-24: 'Maricopa is Elite. always (except for the maricopa county fair)'. A show whose name has the word(s) in match, and none of except, is that tier: the Sheet sync creates new shows with it, and the research runs and the booking sweep treat the show so whatever its tag on the board says.

sync._auto: Alan, 2026-09-28: the board syncs itself from the Sheet every hour, 7am-9pm Phoenix, starting the day after the third clean Wednesday (9/30, 10/7, 10/14). If one of those is not clean, move `from` past the next clean one; null turns it off. The Sync button works either way. A run that stops (parser drift, over the limits) pauses it until a sync gets through (the button or Wednesday's).

_fillDates: scripts/fill-dates.mjs: a show with no Start Date gets one from its own day columns, then VectorConnect, then a page online (Alan, 2026-10-06). More fills than this in one run writes none (the first run had 31).
_maxCostChanges: The event check sets a matched show's cost to VectorConnect's Event Cost (Alan, 2026-10-06: always go off of VC). More differences than this in one run changes none and says so (a broken pull must not rewrite every cost); the first run had 59.
